description.zh: 被抄送人账号id(多个抄送人用逗号分隔)
description.en: The account IDs of the carbon copy recipients. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 业务类目id（如果不传，取工单模板的类目）
description.en: The ID of the tree category. If this parameter is not specified, the category of the ticket template is used.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique client request ID for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID to generate this ID.
The ID of the creator (agent ID).

description.zh:
创建者角色（默认为4：客服），有以下枚举：
1：会员
4：客服
description.en:
The role of the creator. Default value: 4. Valid values:

- 1: member
- 4: customer service representative.

The form configuration of the ticket template, in the format {"key":"value"}. key: the form field code. value: the record value. Example: {"questionInfo":"Automatically created ticket","CFQyYAPjKb":"Delamination"}.
The source from which the ticket is created.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
The ID of the member. Set this parameter to -1 for an anonymous member.

description.zh:
工单优先级，有以下枚举：
普通：4
低：0
中：1
高：2
紧急：3
description.en:
The priority of the ticket. Valid values:

- 4: Normal.
- 0: Low.
- 1: Medium.
- 2: High.
- 3: Urgent.
The ID of the ticket template.
